decisions.reason: After four years the uncertainty around this citrus-specific flagship should be largely resolved, and its disappearance from website visibility suggests the niche has not justified keeping this option open.

A foldable large-container line with several models remains close to the firm's core reusable-packaging business, so even with weaker recent visibility it is still worth keeping as a relatively valuable platform option.

This crate line had limited prominence from the start and, with no observed follow-on presence, management would likely judge that the learning gained no longer warrants continued attention and product complexity.

Spill-retention pallets are a more adjacent and niche application, and after several years without visible market reinforcement the option value looks too low relative to focusing resources elsewhere.
Although it leverages existing pallet capabilities, this narrower pallet variant appears not to have built enough visible traction over time to justify keeping it in the portfolio.
